claim_text_original: An onboard/compact pressure source for jamming is novel.
claim_text_normalized: Generation or modulation of jamming confinement pressure using an embedded, compact, or onboard micropump or actuator mechanism.
why_potentially_novel: At mentor proposal, integrating a miniaturized pressure generator directly on the robot arm was thought to solve the tethering bottleneck of conventional vacuum jamming.
search_conducted: MP1-V001 core prior-art search across IEEE and Elsevier publications on embedded pumps and compact jamming pressure generators.

strongest_prior_art_threat.paper_title: Bidirectional flexible electro-conjugate fluid (ECF) micropump for soft actuators
strongest_prior_art_threat.what_source_actually_proves: Embeds a flexible ECF micropump directly into a soft robotic actuator to generate negative pressure and activate granular jamming locally.
strongest_prior_art_threat.what_source_does_not_prove: Requires external high-voltage supply and reservoir, so it is not completely untethered, but directly invalidates the broad 'embedded/compact jamming source' claim.

source_records.paper_title: Bidirectional flexible electro-conjugate fluid (ECF) micropump for soft actuators
source_records.what_source_actually_proves: Directly integrates a micropump inside an actuator to activate jamming locally.
source_records.what_source_does_not_prove: Does not study NiTi wire bundles.

source_records.paper_title: Piston-like particle jamming for enhanced stiffness adjustment of soft robotic arm
source_records.repository_path: data/papers/verification/MP1-V001/2024-Piston-like particle jamming for enhanced stiffness adjustment of soft robotic arm.pdf
source_records.what_source_actually_proves: Presents a compact modular motorized ball-screw piston mechanism directly mounted on a soft arm to compress jamming particles.
source_records.what_source_does_not_prove: Does not use shape memory alloy actuation.

claim_before: An onboard/compact pressure source for jamming is novel.
claim_after: Onboard and compact jamming pressure generators are established prior art; subsystem novelty rejected.
reason_for_change: Embedded micropumps (Huynh 2022) and motorized piston mechanisms (Wang 2024) directly establish compact local pressure generation for jamming.
scientific_consequence: Compact pressure sourcing is an engineering integration challenge, not a fundamental mechanics contribution.
feasibility_impact: Confirms engineering tractability of compact pressure sources, but eliminates it as a novelty anchor.
pivot_relevance: Key contributor to the decision in MP1-V001 to abandon mechatronic integration claims.
historical_interpretation: Closed at V001 (S04). Confirmed as robust closure at Stage 3 (S12) with clarification that 'compact' does not imply untethered autonomy.
superseded_interpretation: Belief that designing a compact pump or piston mechanism for jamming constituted MSc research novelty.
corrected_interpretation: Compact pressure sources are engineering integration solutions without new mechanics content.
